answer: The triangle and box logarithmic jets are computed exactly. Their individual r^-2 and r^-1 collinear terms cancel those of the bubble in the complete topology sum, leaving 15*(Ls+Lt+Lu) and hence only the ordinary ratio logarithm 15*(3L-ell). Cut-free finite rational terms and the external phase-space projector are not determined.

collinear_expansion.conclusion: All r^-2 and r^-1 terms cancel exactly across the three topology families. A ratio logarithm remains and must be passed through the external phase-space projector before comparison with the real threshold.
